operations.text: A plan's draft and its readiness history live in the repository (DRAFTS-001): the draft is <plansDir>/drafts/PLAN_<ABBR>.draft.md, untracked until it lands in active/; the behavior ledger, the consequence scan, the fact-check ledgers, the own pass and the revisions land in <plansDir>/readiness/<ABBR>/ with the plan's docs commit and stay there; the scratch directory carries the live loop mechanics only and stands in for the draft and the readiness files only while Gate 3 holds the main session out of plansDir - a plansDir outside docs/ during an open R2/R3 route (/pnp:review Step 2e). YOUR LOCAL RULES: a local rule that puts plan drafts or readiness artifacts in the repository can become a one-line pointer to Step 2e. YOUR DIRECTORIES: create <plansDir>/drafts/ and <plansDir>/readiness/ when you first need them - this update creates no directories, and the self-check only observes them (a note, never a failure); it also observes whether git ignores your scratch directory, which setup never arranges for you.
